description: An Employee Experience Director must finalize whether Maya receives the company's Bridge Builder recognition after a difficult cross-team launch, and must determine the citation basis, evidence count, delivery format, audience, and follow-up commitment.

shared_context.S1: Maya was nominated for the company's Bridge Builder recognition after a difficult cross-team launch.
shared_context.S2: The recognition is intended to acknowledge specific interpersonal actions that improved collaboration.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final decision about the recognition and its delivery.
shared_context.S4: As part of the ordinary recognition-panel process, Elena directly asks Ravi for his firsthand observations and Maya for her preferred delivery arrangement before finalizing the recognition.
shared_context.S5: Panel protocol requires each participant's response to be entered into the shared panel record through the formal response step before Elena finalizes the decision; delivery preferences cannot be deferred to a later one-on-one conversation.

PF1.text: Ravi personally observed Maya facilitate exactly two repair sessions between the design and operations teams after handoff disputes; those sessions restored a shared handoff practice, but Ravi never added his observations to the nomination form.

PF2.text: Maya is involved in an ongoing custody matter and has not disclosed it at work; she privately needs recognition delivered as a written note to her and her direct manager only, with no company-wide announcement, photograph, or recording.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must receive the Bridge Builder recognition.
The recognition must be marked as based on repair facilitation.
The record must state exactly two repair sessions.
Recognition must use the Written note delivery format.
Recognition must be addressed only to Maya and her direct manager.
There must be no public announcement.
There must be no photograph or recording.
The settlement must mark the private delivery commitment as complete.

content_checks.C5: decisions['delivery_audience'] == 'Maya and her direct manager only'

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Ravi's observation changes the award record from an unspecified nomination to a repair-facilitation basis with exactly two documented repair sessions.

Maya's personal circumstance changes the delivery format to Written note, restricts the audience to Maya and her direct manager only, prohibits public announcement, photograph, and recording, and requires the private delivery commitment.
